Lityn New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Lityn's Jewish community, established in the 18th century, survived a pogrom on May 13–16, 1919, that killed 400 people and left over 4,000 more harmed. The violinist, conductor, and teacher David Solomonovich Berthier (Livshits) was born here in 1882. On December 19, 1941, 1,986 Jews were murdered at a nearby army base; 2,250 were executed in Lityn in total during the occupation. A local Jewish resident told the survey team that Lityn has several Jewish cemeteries, though could not provide exact locations, and that preservation funds for this cemetery come from a named benefactor, Mr. Senya Schmidt of Philadelphia; no concrete evidence of additional cemeteries could be found.
